$comment: Provider pack: docling layout-aware document extraction (complex tables, multi-column, scanned PDFs where markitdown returns garbage). Deep-merged by deploy/merge-packs.mjs when the user passes --enable-pack docling (v2 shape: mcp.servers.<name>.disabled:false + permissions array rule). NOTE: docling-mcp[local] must be installed first (setup.sh does this via install_docling; ~3-4 GB with models from huggingface.co on first convert). Appends the permissions rule {"action": "docling*", "resource": "*", "effect": "allow"} so the merge flips the shipped deny.
